live.instructions: deals-search returns Groupon deals for a named area. Deals are available in the United States and Canada only; a location outside those markets is not covered by this connector and returns an unsupported-region message rather than results. A search requires a location and cannot infer one; an area it does not recognise returns a corrective error message rather than results. Search text is matched in English; a query in another language finds more deals once translated. Results can be narrowed by search text, price, rating, online bookability and gifting occasion, and ordered by relevance, price, distance or rating. No other filter or sort is available. Results render as a list. Each response carries a feedToken; a subsequent search with the same search and sorting and that token returns the next page; the last page carries no token. deal-details returns everything known about one deal — description, fine print, options, redemption locations, reviews and availability — for a deal uuid that a deals-search result carries.

tools.name: deal-details
tools.title: Groupon deal details
tools.description: Returns the full detail of one Groupon deal, identified by the deal uuid a deals-search result carries. The answer has six parts: description and highlights, fine print, every purchase option with its price and selling state, every redemption location, the review summary, and availability with the merchant name and website. Long fields and long lists are shortened, and the answer states what was shortened.

dealId.description: Deal uuid, as it appears in a deals-search result (structuredContent.deals[].uuid), e.g. 'cb6d7944-4baf-46c8-9521-8a302c9fe473'. The slug in a deal URL is a different identifier.

optionId.description: Option uuid from the same deal, as deals-search carries it in optionId. The matching option is listed first and marked as selected. A value that is not a uuid is rejected, the same as for dealId. An empty value counts as omitted.

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/error: Unable to load this deal's details.

url.description: Deal page on groupon.com, with channel attribution parameters.

description.description: Deal description and highlights as plain text, shortened when long.

finePrint.description: Fine print as plain text, shortened when long.

optionStatus.description: BUY, SOLD_OUT, EXPIRED, NOT_YET or QTY_EXCEEDED.

isSelected.description: True for the option named in optionId.

amount.description: Minor units; divide by 10^currencyExponent for the display amount.

formattedAmount.description: The amount as the consumer API formats it, e.g. '$24.00'.

suffix.description: Qualifies what the amount buys, e.g. 'per night'.

endAt.description: When the option stops being on sale.

options.description: Purchase options, at most 30, the pinned one first.

optionsTotal.description: How many options the deal has in total.

locations.description: Redemption locations, at most 25, in consumer-API order.

locationsTotal.description: How many redemption locations the deal has in total. Null when the deal has no locations at all.

rating.description: Average rating as the consumer API reports it, a string on a 5-point scale.

reviewsCount.description: How many written reviews the deal has. Not the population the rating averages.

total.description: How many ratings the rating is the average of. Can differ from reviewsCount.

tools.name: deals-search
tools.title: Search for Groupon deals
tools.description: Searches Groupon's consumer deal feed for a given area and returns the matching deals. Each deal carries its title, merchant, price, rating and a link to the deal page on groupon.com. Results can be narrowed by search text, price range, minimum rating, online bookability and gifting occasion, and ordered by relevance, price, distance or rating. Under price or rating sorting the result is up to 100 most relevant deals, sorted by price or rating, and total is the size of that set. A cursor from a different search or sorting is rejected. The deal-details tool answers with the full detail of any one of these deals, keyed by its uuid.

view.description: Presentation of the results. Only `list` is rendered today. Default: list.

searchQuery.description: Search text, in English (e.g., 'burger', 'spa', 'massage'). A specific term matches better than a broad one. Boolean OR and AND operators are not supported.

count.description: Number of deals to return (optional, defaults to 5, maximum 15).

offset.description: The count of deals already listed for this search (optional, defaults to 0); the numbering of a chained page continues from it. Paging is driven by feedToken; offset does not select which page the feed returns.

feedToken.description: Pagination cursor carried from a previous response's structuredContent.feedToken; chaining it returns the next page of results. The cursor continues the feed the original search opened. Under price or rating sorting, a cursor from a different search or sorting is rejected.

searchArea.description: Deal search area, formatted as "City, State, Country" or "Neighborhood, City, State, Country" (e.g., 'New York, NY, USA', 'Wicker Park, Chicago, IL, USA', 'Toronto, Ontario, CA')

priceMin.description: Minimum price. All prices returned in the response are in USD and multiplied by 100 (e.g., $10.00 is returned as 1000). However, for this field, provide the standard USD amount (do not multiply by 100).

priceMax.description: Maximum price. All prices returned in the response are in USD and multiplied by 100 (e.g., $10.00 is returned as 1000). However, for this field, provide the standard USD amount (do not multiply by 100).

rating.description: Minimum star rating on a 5-point scale. Must be between 1 and 5.

isBookableOnline.description: Indicates whether deals are bookable online (optional)

isGiftable.description: Whether to return only deals suitable as gifts. When true, giftingFlags narrows results by recipient, interest or occasion.

giftingFlags.description: Gifting characteristics that narrow the results by recipient, interest or occasion. Applies only alongside isGiftable.

sorting.description: Sorting criteria for the search results (optional). Default: relevance

userConfirmedRefine.description: Marks a repeat search within the same conversation step as intended rather than accidental.

refineIntent.description: Reason the results are being refined: 'sort' | 'filter' | 'expand' | 'location_change' | 'other'

_meta.openai/toolInvocation/invoked: Done! Check out the results below.
_meta.openai/toolInvocation/error: Unable to search for deals. Please make sure you've provided your location.

optionTitle.description: Title of the option the price belongs to. A deal's title describes the deal; this names the one thing actually on sale at that price - often a voucher or a specific duration rather than the headline service.

url.description: Deal page on groupon.com, with channel attribution parameters.

adId.description: Always null: paid placements are excluded from this tool's results.

amount.description: Minor units; divide by 10^currencyExponent for the display amount.

suffix.description: Qualifies what the amount buys, e.g. 'per night'.

formatted.description: Pre-formatted runs of the price, joined for display: `$` `1` `,` `795`. Carries the feed's own currency placement and grouping, which `amount` alone does not.

strikeThroughPrice.description: Former price, shown struck through when it exceeds the current price.

isStartingPrice.description: True when the price is a 'from' price on a multi-option or travel deal.

displayOptions.description: Presentation switches from the feed. `hidePriceOnLoggedOut` marks a price the web card shows only to signed-in members; the widget renders it as a member price.

deals.description: The deals on this page, in result order.

total.description: Number of deals matching the search across all pages. Under price or rating sorting, the size of the most-relevant set that was sorted.

view.description: Presentation the results were requested in. Only `list` is rendered today.

feedToken.description: Pagination cursor; pass it back as feedToken to fetch the next page. Null when there is no next page.
